rules.statement: Notice does not need to be given upon instituting a case under the provisions of S.22.
rules.supporting_quote: (i) There is no requirement that Notice should be given when a case is instituted according to the provisions of S.22(1)d. (ii) When the Plaint states that he was convicted that conviction itself suffice to file an action for the ejectment of the tenant. (iii) With the conviction of the tenant the tenancy agreement comes to an end. The conviction itself can be regarded as a termination of the tenancy agreement
